sloka: भवान्हि गतिरव्यग्रा भवता पालिता वयम् ।भवतस्तेजसोग्रेण रावणो निहतो मया ।। ७.३८.३ ॥
transliteration: bhavānhi gatiravyagrā bhavatā pālitā vayam ।bhavatastejasogreṇa rāvaṇo nihato mayā ।। 7.38.3 ॥

translations.english: You are indeed our steadfast refuge, and we have been protected by you; it was by your fierce might that Ravana was killed by me.
translations.hindi: उस समग्र क्या कोई राजा या अन्य कोई राजपुरुष एसा न रह गया था, जो रावण को दबा सकता !
